name: Zuari

sink.name: Mormugao Harbour, near Vasco da Gama
sink.location: South Goa district, Goa, Arabian Sea

did_you_know: Goa's longest river, the Zuari was historically also called the Aghanashini ('destroyer of sins') in the state's interior — a name it shares, confusingly, with an entirely separate river of the same name further south in coastal Karnataka.
The Cumbarjua Canal links the Zuari to the neighbouring Mandovi River, letting ore-laden ships reach Goa's interior mining belt.
Together the Zuari and Mandovi meet the Arabian Sea at a common point, Cabo Aguada, forming Mormugao Harbour, one of India's principal natural harbours.
